title: Discussion
description: A structured conversation thread attached to a Concept or Article.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: A short descriptive title for this discussion thread.

subject.description: ID of the Concept or Article this discussion is anchored to.

subject_type.description: Whether the subject is a concept or article.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this discussion was opened.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the most recent activity.

resolution.description: ID of the Decision artifact that resolved this discussion (required when status is 'resolved').

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.
